message:
MDpanel is mass hiring medical record reviewers. 20 in one batch tells me volume is outpacing what the current process can handle.

Brighterway was built for QME and IME work. It organises records, filters out the 80% that is irrelevant, generates AI summaries, and lets physicians write reports without leaving the platform. Cheaper than growing headcount.

Is this something you are actively looking at?
